scope: Fourteen non-P0 arm/seed selected laws, each replayed separately on FIT and INNER: 28 queue units after R2/R3 outputs. P0 has a separate completed independent source replay.
input_contract: Each queue unit pins its R3 private config, every referenced role-only file, selected law, P0 wire, public original-ID bank, R3 CSV and receipt, and the current verification amendment. It deserializes only the selected FIT or INNER task labels and references after pin checks; never SEX, HEAD, old assessment or all-role archives.
independent_endpoints: Exact expected sampled-output accuracy, NLL and multiclass Brier from original public bank codes and selected per-person mass
All six FIT P0-relative or twelve INNER U0/Ucal-relative primary clauses per arm/seed/role
All 54 actual single-draw task/reference clauses per arm/seed/role on the exact three cached public code releases, with positive-law support
Independent Decimal80 arithmetic check against the predeclared 1e-10 envelope
Frozen same-class action support and first-slot exact P0 identity
R3 source margin and strict point status comparison; a discrepancy wholly within the predeclared envelope is explicitly NUMERIC_BOUNDARY_UNRESOLVED
not_yet_covered: FIT crossfold reader guard and checkpoint selection replay
Fresh attack AUC and paired simultaneous intervals
selection_independence: Worker imports no R2/R3 policy, endpoint, scoring or selection implementation; it consumes frozen artifacts only.
